verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator is a consumer TOTP app with cloud sync. A buyer could reasonably ask whether it offers programmatic access, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only in-app UI flows and QR-code transfer, and no OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable API spec is documented. The open-source HOTP/TOTP implementations and PAM module are developer building blocks, not a downloadable API spec, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
